name: code-enhance
description: Run check-by-check, evidence-driven, read-only code reviews through independent finder and validator agents.

interface.shortDescription: Auditable multi-agent code and architecture review.
interface.longDescription: Review repositories, development changes, and version evolution through three independent check-by-check handbooks followed by fresh evidence validation, with strict read-only behavior, complete coverage ledgers, and explicit resistance to over-design.
defaultPrompt: Use $code-enhance:review to review the entire repository, focusing on code quality, architecture, and security.
Use $code-enhance:review to review my latest development changes and identify verified risks.
Use $code-enhance:review to compare v1.2.0, v1.3.0, and v2.0.0 and summarize the code-quality trend.
